config_source: Defaults from 3d58143:experiments/train_decoder_muon.py; vocab size from the referenced tokenizer.

method.forward_backward: CUDA events; fixed packed-varlen batch; zero_grad, loss, and backward included.
method.graph_forward_backward: Same work with Python layer dispatch removed by CUDA Graph; position IDs are precomputed before capture.
method.full_step: CUDA events; AdamW step and FP8 weight-cache refresh included.
method.mfu: Useful model FLOPs divided by nominal 419 TFLOPS FP8 peak. BF16 O projection, lm head, and attention are included in the numerator, so this is conservative for mixed precision.

graph_forward_backward.unavailable: FLA fused linear cross-entropy synchronizes on the host to count valid targets and is not CUDA Graph capturable.
